features.name: Binary Scheduled Output & Daemon Replay
features.contractDescription: Coalesced Uint8Array output stream via RAF and 128 KiB threshold flush; daemon sequence/epoch tracking with gap handling.
features.notes: Source-audited; dedicated command evidence remains required before native parity sign-off.

features.name: Resize Observer & Viewport Preservation
features.contractDescription: ResizeObserver on terminal container element, debounced RAF refit, preserves scroll-to-bottom anchor, syncs cols/rows over IPC.

features.name: Keystroke & Pointer Input Forwarding
features.contractDescription: terminal.onData dispatches keystrokes and escape sequences directly to daemon PTY via writeTerminal IPC; pointerdown focuses terminal.

features.name: Window & Tab Title Reporting
features.contractDescription: OSC 0 and OSC 2 sequence handling via terminal.onTitleChange updates tab and workspace session title.

features.name: Terminal Bell (BEL) Notification
features.contractDescription: BEL (0x07) trigger dispatches terminal.onBell callback for tab badge and audio/visual alerts.

features.name: Search Overlay & Addon Navigation
features.contractDescription: @xterm/addon-search provides findNext / findPrevious, regex, case sensitivity, and whole word searching over active buffer.

features.name: Unicode 11 Extended VTE Addon
features.contractDescription: Loads @xterm/addon-unicode11 dynamically in factory and sets activeVersion='11' for wcwidth on emoji and CJK wide glyphs.
features.notes: Source-audited in ui/src/lib/terminalInstanceFactory.ts; dynamic loading seam present in UI but lacks dedicated vitest UI test file; manual QA required.

features.name: WebGL Hardware Accelerated Rendering
features.contractDescription: Asynchronously loads @xterm/addon-webgl for GPU acceleration; falls back cleanly to canvas/DOM rendering if context fails.

features.name: Theme, Font, and Scrollback Configuration
features.contractDescription: Saves and resolves font stack, font size (10-36), scrollback (1k-100k), cursorStyle, macosOptionAsAlt, and 24-bit theme palette.

features.name: Desktop Tauri vs Browser Runtime Boundary
features.contractDescription: isTauriRuntime() guards IPC PTY session creation; browser preview environment renders simulated preview prompt banner.

fontFamily.default: Berkeley Mono, JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.name: Idle CPU Under Multi-Session Load
unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.contractDescription: Zero-activity background PTY sessions must exhibit <= 0.1% CPU wake-up frequency on macOS Activity Monitor.
unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.notes: Unmeasured real-surface scenario: requires macOS Instruments / Activity Monitor profiling under live 10-pane daemon session.

unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.name: Real Surface Tab Switch Frame Latency
unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.contractDescription: Switching between active output tabs must render the new terminal buffer in < 16.6ms (1 frame) without layout reflow glitch.
unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.notes: Unmeasured real-surface scenario: host manager unit mocks exist, but real display frame budget requires manual QA / profiler.

unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.name: Interactive Split Pane Continuous Drag FPS
unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.contractDescription: Continuous mouse dragging on pane divider under active terminal throughput sustains >= 60 FPS without DOM stall.
unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.notes: Unmeasured real-surface scenario: requires Chrome DevTools Performance recording during live split drag.

unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.name: Process Crash / Reload Terminal State Recovery
unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.contractDescription: Full desktop application reload restores active terminal sessions, scroll position, and PTY connection without data loss.
unmeasuredRealSurfaceScenarios.notes: Unmeasured real-surface scenario: store logic is test-verified, but Tauri process relaunch requires manual QA validation.
